definitions.gloss: judicial system; judiciary; administration of justice
definitions.explanation: The system of courts and judges that interprets and applies the law.

examples.japanese: {司法|しほう}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
{司法|しほう}の{独立|どくりつ}は{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{立法|りっぽう}、{行政|ぎょうせい}、{司法|しほう}の{三権|さんけん}{分立|ぶんりつ}。
examples.english: Separation of the three powers: legislative, executive, and judicial.

notes:
{司法|しほう} refers to the judicial branch of government and legal system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {司法|しほう}{試験|しけん} (bar examination)
- {司法|しほう}{制度|せいど} (judicial system)
- {司法|しほう}{書士|しょし} (judicial scrivener)
- {司法|しほう}{取引|とりひき} (plea bargain)

THREE BRANCHES:
- {立法|りっぽう} (legislative)
- {行政|ぎょうせい} (executive)
- {司法|しほう} (judicial)
